core_claim.P: Owner submits a transaction calling ShareTokenUpgradeable::unregisterVault on a vault whose balance is zero
core_claim.I: unregisterVault must succeed in removing the vault; the function reverts if the vault's balanceOf > 0
core_claim.V: A malicious user front-runs by directly transferring a dust amount of asset to the vault, making its balance non-zero, so unregisterVault reverts and the vault cannot be removed

distinct_impacts.description: Denial of service of core protocol functionality: the owner is unable to remove/unregister the vault
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: Denial of service of core functionality of the protocol. If by any reason the owner wants to remove the vault, he wont be able to do so

distinct_impacts.description: Front-running the owner's unregisterVault transaction with a direct dust asset transfer makes the vault balance non-zero
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: A malicious user can exploit this by front running the owner's tx of `unregisterVault` by directly transferring dust amount of asset to the vault which will make the balance of the contract non zero

distinct_impacts.description: unregisterVault reverts because the vault has any balance (balanceOf > 0)
distinct_impacts.evidence_quote: the transaction will rvert if the vault has any balance i.e `balanceOf > 0`
